page.overview:
Who is The Beautifuls?

The Beautifuls are a group of 4 (later 5) girls from the Fazbear Frights Story, To Be Beautiful. It's important to note that this not their official name, but rather what Sarah calls them.

Lydia: The "leader" of the Beautifuls, she has long honey blonde hair and cerulean blue eyes. Jillian: One of the fellow beautifuls, she has ginger hair and emerald green eyes that Sarah describes as being like a cat.

Tabitha: The only African American of the group, she has curly black hair, dark skin and dark eyes.
